submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE: 1.53% at Sb 0.448. EQE rises from Sb 0.24 (0.46%) to 0.35 (1.39%) to 0.45 (1.53%). It falls to about 0.03–0.06% on the Sb-rich side (0.675, 0.816). XRD shows the same single phase from Sb 0.19 to 0.52, so the best region is the Sb-richer part of that phase.
